Name: Set up subscription tiers in Stripe
Description:
Create three subscription tiers in Stripe with the following pricing and features:
- Basic: $29/month - Basic access to AI model selection tool and limited feature set
- Pro: $49/month - Additional features and priority support
- Enterprise: $99/month - All features, custom support, and integration options

Ensure each tier is correctly configured in Stripe with accurate pricing, billing cycle (monthly), and feature metadata so they can be referenced by both frontend and backend systems. Acceptance criteria: All three tiers are visible and correctly configured in the Stripe dashboard.

Name: Build frontend checkout flow with Stripe Elements
Description:
Implement the checkout process using Stripe Elements. Requirements:
- Customize the Stripe Elements form to match the app's design (clean and straightforward)
- Make the checkout button prominent
- Handle potential errors gracefully (invalid card details, insufficient funds, etc.) with clear user-facing messages
- Include a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if the user chooses a different plan later

Acceptance criteria: Checkout form is styled consistently with the app, errors are displayed clearly, and tooltips are present and informative.

Name: Update pricing page with subscription tiers and feature comparison
Description:
Update the existing pricing page to reflect the three new subscription tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise). Requirements:
- Display pricing for each tier ($29, $49, $99 per month)
- Provide a clear feature comparison across all tiers so users can easily understand what each plan includes
- Ensure the design is clean and the checkout button is prominent

Acceptance criteria: Pricing page displays all three tiers with accurate pricing and a clear feature comparison table.

Name: Build user dashboard for subscription management
Description:
Create a user dashboard that allows users to manage their subscriptions. Required functionalities:
- Display current plan details and billing info
- Options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscription
- Access to invoices and payment history
- Ability to update payment methods
- Real-time reflection of current subscription status
- Notifications for changes (e.g., successful plan upgrades, payment failures)

The dashboard should be intuitive and user-friendly. Acceptance criteria: All listed functionalities are implemented and the dashboard updates in real-time based on backend subscription status.

Name: Integrate Stripe API for backend subscription management
Description:
Implement backend integration with Stripe's API to handle all subscription-related tasks:
- Creating subscriptions when a user selects a plan and completes payment
- Processing payments (handling both successful and failed payments)
- Managing webhooks for various subscription events

Acceptance criteria: Backend can create subscriptions, process payments, and correctly communicate with Stripe's API for all subscription operations.

Name: Set up webhook handlers for Stripe events
Description:
Create webhook handlers on the backend for the following Stripe events:
1. invoice.payment_succeeded - Confirm successful payments and activate/continue the user's subscription
2. invoice.payment_failed - Notify users of failed payments, prompt them to update payment information, and send an email notification
3. customer.subscription.deleted - Manage subscription cancellations, update access rights, and optionally offer re-subscription

Each handler must correctly update the internal system state based on the event. Acceptance criteria: All three webhook handlers are implemented, tested, and correctly update the system and notify users as needed.

Name: Create comprehensive test plan for subscription flow
Description:
Prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests for the entire subscription lifecycle:
- Sign-up flow for each tier
- Billing and payment processing (success and failure scenarios)
- Subscription management (upgrade, downgrade, cancel)
- Webhook event handling (payment succeeded, payment failed, subscription deleted)
- Edge cases (e.g., payment failures, cancellations, plan changes mid-cycle)

Share the test plan with the team for review. Acceptance criteria: Test plan document is created, shared, and covers all subscription flows and edge cases.

Name: Integrate frontend with backend subscription API
Description:
Once the backend API is ready, integrate the frontend components with the backend API endpoints. Requirements:
- Ensure any changes to subscriptions are reflected in real-time on the user dashboard
- Handle errors during the integration process and provide clear notifications to users (e.g., payment failure instructions)
- Display user notifications for different events like subscription confirmations and payment errors

Acceptance criteria: Frontend correctly communicates with backend, subscription changes reflect in real-time, and errors are clearly communicated to users.

Name: Create user documentation and FAQ for subscription management
Description:
Create user-facing documentation and a help section/FAQ covering:
- How to manage subscriptions (upgrade, downgrade, cancel)
- How to access invoices and payment history
- How to update payment methods
- Common issues and questions about subscriptions
- Clear instructions for handling problems

Acceptance criteria: A help section or FAQ is published and accessible to users, covering all common subscription-related topics.

Name: Document API endpoints and webhook event handlers
Description:
Create technical documentation for all API endpoints and webhook event handlers related to the Stripe integration. This includes:
- Descriptions of each endpoint and its purpose
- Request/response formats
- Webhook event handler descriptions and their behavior
- Troubleshooting notes for future maintenance

Acceptance criteria: Documentation is complete, accurate, and stored in a location accessible to the development team for future reference.

Name: Schedule and conduct follow-up progress review meeting
Description:
Schedule a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the Stripe subscription integration. Agenda should include:
- Review progress on frontend, backend, and testing tasks
- Address any blockers or issues encountered
- Coordinate next steps for the remaining work

Acceptance criteria: Meeting is scheduled with all team members and an agenda is shared in advance.
